operator_plan.name: Resolve the two genuine follow-ups
operator_plan.detail: Quick task 260808-u2q, commits 71773ee (plan) and 92998de..5d60ea4. (a) CLOSED by mechanism: publish now carries `&& !github.event.forced`, so a restore (a rewind, therefore forced) skips it while a window-open push (a fast-forward) still publishes. publish-verify follows via needs. Research corrected the premise: ELEVEN prior restore pushes, not five -- backup refs are reused by name so they cannot count events -- and FOUR of those runs published for real (not five; the fifth success is the merge push that CREATED fe25a3f and SHOULD have published). (b) CLOSED as a triage rather than a fix: 69bd1b7 is docs-only, no CI run ever existed, output was discarded by a redirect. Unactionable until it recurs WITH output, so the work was capture -- the tee idiom now lives in AGENTS.md with its status captured to a variable rather than `exit` (which would end the battery loop after one iteration) and an iteration suffix on the log name (one-second timestamps collapse fast iterations). Verifier human_needed 4/6: the two RUNTIME directions are item 3's to observe.

operator_plan.name: Close the two open-by-design observations
operator_plan.detail: Phase 9's first post-merge publish-verify (windows-11-arm) leg, and Phase 10's OBS-01 summary + shard census. Both require a real push to main that RUNS the publish legs -- they are gated off pull_request events and were skipped on run 30947535877. Operator APPROVED a temporary main window (backup before, restore after) as the instrument, and PROHIBITED using a merge. Run via /gsd-core:quick --full with discuss-phase --auto semantics. MUST be done AFTER item 2, because item 2 fixes the defect in the very procedure item 3 uses. WINDOW PROCEDURE -- THREE HOPS, CORRECTED 2026-08-08. The two-hop version recorded earlier was WRONG and would have failed on a correct gate. A push event runs the workflow at the PUSHED TIP (GITHUB_SHA is documented as the tip commit pushed to the ref, and the push trigger "includes workflows that are not merged into the default branch" -- only possible if the workflow comes from the pushed commit). The restore lands on fe25a3f, which PREDATES the !github.event.forced clause, so that hop runs the UNGATED workflow and publishes exactly as before. The clause is correct but DORMANT for restores until main itself contains it, which is at merge, which the maintainer has placed LAST -- after additional code and security reviews over the proven milestone. HOP 1, open: `git push origin HEAD:main` -- a plain push, never --force. Fast-forward, gated workflow, forced=false. EXPECT publish + publish-verify to RUN. This hop delivers item 3s own two observations (the windows-11-arm publish-verify leg, and the OBS-01 summary + shard census). HOP 2, the skip proof: rewind main to 43f3612, a forced push whose tip DOES carry the clause. EXPECT publish SKIPPED and publish-verify SKIPPED by cascade, with no POST to /releases. 43f3612s ci.yml is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the feature tips (verified with git diff), so forced is the ONLY variable between hop 1 and hop 2 -- a controlled experiment the original design could not have produced. HOP 3, restore: rewind main to fe25a3f. This hop runs the UNGATED workflow, so DISABLE the ci.yml workflow for this one push and re-enable immediately after. Verify the disable mechanism BEFORE relying on it, and verify main == fe25a3f and the workflow is re-enabled at the end. Never open a window while a previous one is still open: a tip that does not descend from the tip already on main is a rewind, and on a gated tip that now SKIPS publish -- so the measurement is silently lost rather than merely wrong. RECORD BOTH DIRECTIONS. Recording only the skip would leave an over-broad gate undetected: a clause that skips everything satisfies the restore direction and destroys the instrument.

decisions.decision: The merge is gated behind additional code reviews and security reviews, which are themselves gated behind proving everything the milestone claims
decisions.rationale: Stated by the maintainer 2026-08-08 as the REASON for the merge prohibition, which had until then been recorded as a bare rule. The order is: (1) prove every open observation -- the temporary main windows do this; (2) additional code review and security review over the proven result; (3) the merge decision. So "all the evidence is in" is NOT an argument for merging -- it is the argument for STARTING step 2. That is the inference an agent gets wrong, because from inside step 1 the work looks finished and a green board reads as permission. Corollary: anything landing on the branch late -- the 260808-u2q ci.yml gate and its spec assertion, for instance -- POSTDATES the milestone audit and belongs in step 2 scope. The quick review it got during its own task is not the review being planned.

context_notes: The through-line across every task this session: a claim that LOOKS like coverage and asserts nothing is caught only by an independent pass, never by its author -- and a FIX deserves the same scrutiny as the original. Item 1 produced six fresh instances. The sharpest is the last: the verifier's single gap was a five-week interval stated AS MEASURED in the plan, never measured, that then propagated into the summary twice and into STATE.md on the strength of the assertion. Five weeks after 2026-07-26 is a future date, so it was unreachable, not merely wrong. Then the sweep to correct it hit the same line-wrap dead-literal trap the task documents as an anti-pattern: the phrase search failed in the plan and succeeded in the other three files, so a three-of-four sweep would have read as complete. Carry forward the measured false-zero shapes, each of which reads as confident absence: a literal spanning a line wrap; rg -U with \s+ cannot bridge a wrap whose continuation carries a '#' (use [\s#]+); a SHAPE-anchored regex failing because a file records verdicts as headings rather than table rows. Always check the exit code (1 = genuine no-match, 2 = the command FAILED) and run a positive control on the same path. And git grep needs -e when the pattern starts with '-'. Two more from item 1 worth keeping: a plan's own verification step can be UNSATISFIABLE by construction (T1/T2 scope gates excluded STATE.md while T3 required it dirty -- no tree state satisfies all three), which is a finding to report rather than a gate to weaken; and a region gate that greps the wrong heading LEVEL is satisfied by unrelated prose, so it proves nothing while reading as coverage.
